defaults.motion_elements: the lamp glow, the fire and the snow outside
defaults.ambient: The fire flickers. Snow falls outside the workshop windows.

shots.subject: A vast timber-beamed toy workshop with long oak workbenches covered in half-carved wooden toys, rows of hanging brass lamps, a big stone fireplace crackling at the far end and tall arched windows showing snow falling on dark pine trees

A worn oak workbench with half-painted wooden rocking horses, carving chisels laid on a leather roll, a pot of red paint and curls of pine shavings, a green-shaded brass lamp glowing above and a frosted window with falling snow behind
shots.motion_elements: the lamp glow and the snow outside the window
shots.ambient: Snow falls outside the window. The lamp glows softly.

shots.subject: A tall wall of wooden shelves packed with finished toys, wooden soldiers, spinning tops, drums and little dolls' houses, tied with red and green ribbons, fairy lights along every shelf, a rolling library ladder and a round window at the end with falling snow
shots.motion_elements: the shelf fairy lights and the snow outside the round window
shots.ambient: Snow falls outside the round window.

shots.subject: A red wooden sleigh with gold scrollwork and leather seats parked on the plank floor in the middle of the workshop, piled with wrapped gifts and burlap sacks, lanterns hanging from the rafters and big barn doors half open onto a snowy yard
shots.motion_elements: the lanterns and the snow falling beyond the open doors
shots.ambient: Snow falls in the yard beyond the open barn doors. The lantern flames flicker gently.

shots.subject: A long wrapping table with rolls of red, green and gold paper on wall-mounted wooden spindles, spools of satin ribbon, stacks of plain boxes and twine, pendant lamps glowing overhead and a small-paned window with falling snow
shots.motion_elements: the pendant lamps and the snow outside the window

shots.subject: An old roll-top desk with a green banker's lamp, bundles of blank unaddressed envelopes tied with twine and sealed with red wax, a quill in a brass inkwell and a lit candle, a frosted window with falling snow behind
shots.motion_elements: the candle flame, the lamp glow and the snow outside
shots.ambient: The candle flame flickers. Snow falls outside the window.

shots.subject: A workshop stone fireplace with a roaring log fire, a row of knitted red and green stockings on the mantel, a pine garland with red berries, two leather armchairs and a line of freshly finished wooden toy trains on the hearth
shots.motion_elements: the fire and the fairy lights on the garland
shots.ambient: The fire flickers and crackles in the hearth.

shots.subject: Rows of freshly painted wooden nutcracker figures drying on a wooden rack beside jars of brushes and pots of red, green and gold paint, a warm clamp work lamp and a small-paned window with falling snow
shots.motion_elements: the work lamp glow and the snow outside

shots.subject: A two-level toy workshop seen from a wooden mezzanine railing wrapped in garland, workbenches and toy-filled shelves on the floor below, strings of warm lights across the rafters, a glowing pot-bellied iron stove and big windows with falling snow
shots.ambient: The stove fire glows and flickers. Snow falls outside the windows.

shots.subject: An antique treadle sewing machine on a wooden table with half-stitched red velvet stockings, spools of red and green thread, a basket of felt star ornaments, a warm table lamp and a frosted window with falling snow
shots.motion_elements: the lamp glow and the snow outside the window

shots.subject: A tinker's bench scattered with brass gears, tiny wind-up tin toys and fine screwdrivers, a magnifying lamp glowing over them and a mug of cocoa steaming beside, workshop lights in soft bokeh behind
shots.motion_elements: the steam from the mug and the bokeh lights
shots.ambient: Steam rises gently from the mug of cocoa.

shots.subject: The workshop's tall arched double doors seen from inside, framed with a thick pine garland and a big wreath, lanterns on iron hooks, a wooden toy wagon full of wrapped gifts waiting by the door and snow falling past the glass panes
shots.motion_elements: the lanterns and the snow falling beyond the glass
shots.ambient: Snow falls outside the glass door panes. The lantern flames flicker gently.

shots.subject: A big test layout on a workshop table where a hand-built wooden toy train circles carved wooden hills and little wooden trees, work lamps glowing above and a window with falling snow behind
shots.motion_elements: the wooden toy train, the lamp glow and the snow outside
shots.ambient: The wooden toy train rolls slowly around the track. Snow falls outside the window.

shots.subject: A glass-ornament corner with a small brick furnace glowing orange through its open port, racks of hand-blown red and gold baubles cooling, long copper tools on hooks and a window with falling snow
shots.motion_elements: the furnace glow, the reflections in the baubles and the snow outside
shots.ambient: The fire glows and flickers inside the furnace. Snow falls outside the window.

shots.subject: A storage loft under a sloping timber roof stacked high with gifts wrapped in red, green and gold paper and tied with ribbons, burlap sacks and wooden crates, fairy lights along the beams and a small dormer window with falling snow
shots.motion_elements: the fairy lights on the beams and the snow outside the dormer
shots.ambient: Snow falls outside the dormer window.

shots.subject: A woodworking corner with an old wooden lathe, turned spindles and sawdust, small wooden sleds hanging on the plank wall, hanging lanterns and a cast-iron stove glowing through its grate
shots.ambient: The stove fire glows and flickers. The lantern flames flicker gently.
shots.motion_elements: the stove fire and the lanterns

shots.subject: The workshop at closing time, tools hung neatly on a pegboard wall, a line of finished toys waiting on the bench under a single glowing lamp, embers in the fireplace and snow drifting past the windows

A cozy break corner of the workshop with a copper kettle steaming on a small wood stove, enamel mugs on hooks, a plate of cookies on a checked red cloth, a garland over the window and snow falling outside
shots.motion_elements: the steam from the kettle, the stove fire and the snow outside
shots.ambient: Steam rises from the kettle. The stove fire flickers. Snow falls outside the window.

shots.subject: A wooden tray of freshly carved toy ornaments, stars, little trees and tiny sleighs, with a carving knife and pine shavings, a candle lantern glowing beside it and the workshop lights in soft bokeh behind
shots.motion_elements: the lantern candle flame and the bokeh lights
shots.ambient: The candle flame flickers inside the lantern.

shots.subject: The whole workshop seen from the far doorway, a long aisle between workbenches and toy shelves leading to a giant decorated Christmas tree in the centre, lamps glowing everywhere and a fireplace burning at the end
shots.motion_elements: the tree lights, the lamp glow and the fire
